prompt: Make a 5-second logo intro for a coffee brand called "Nắng Coffee". Warm, premium feel. The brand name appears, then the tagline "Rang mộc mỗi sáng". End on a clean hold of the logo lockup for the last second.

A 15-second vertical TikTok ad for wireless earbuds called "Pulse Buds". Bold kinetic text, one idea per beat: 30-hour battery, active noise cancelling, IPX5 water resistance. End with the price 1.290.000₫ and "Mua ngay". No stock footage: build it from shapes, text and effects.

A 20-second lyric video section. Lines, each on screen about 4 seconds, in this order: "Đêm nay thành phố không ngủ" / "Ánh đèn rơi trên vai em" / "Mình đi qua những con phố cũ" / "Và quên hết những muộn phiền". Dreamy night-city mood, slow drifting light, each line enters differently but the whole stays one piece.

An 8-second YouTube end screen for a cooking channel called "Bếp Nhà Lan": thanks-for-watching title, two video placeholders (one "Video tiếp theo", one "Xem nhiều nhất"), and a subscribe button that gets clicked. Friendly, warm, clean.

An 18-second explainer segment with three statistics about remote work: 58% of workers can work remotely at least one day a week; productivity up 13%; 74% say flexibility is the top reason to stay. Numbers count up, each stat has its own moment, and a small bar chart compares the three at the end. Corporate but not boring.
A 10-second square Instagram invite for "Saigon Design Meetup" — Saturday 21 March 2026, 7 pm, The Hive, Thảo Điền. Free entry, link in bio. Playful, modern, colorful, with the date as the hero.
An 8-second vertical quote reel: “Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” — Leonardo da Vinci. Elegant typography, slow and confident, a subtle textured background with depth, nothing else.
A 9-second New Year countdown: the numbers 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 each take one second with impact, then fireworks and confetti with the title "Chúc mừng năm mới 2027". Festive, gold and deep blue.

A 12-second slide for an investor update: headline "Doanh thu tăng 3,4× trong 4 năm", then a line chart of yearly revenue 2022: 12 tỷ, 2023: 18 tỷ, 2024: 27 tỷ, 2025: 41 tỷ that draws on over time with the values labeled. Clean, trustworthy, one accent color.

A 10-second broadcast-news style open: a headline "Giá xăng giảm lần thứ ba liên tiếp" with a lower third for the reporter "Minh Anh — Phóng viên kinh tế", a ticker strip at the bottom and a small live badge. Blue and white, crisp, professional. No video: use a dark studio-like background.

A 12-second vertical kinetic typography piece for the sentence "Làm ít thôi, nhưng làm cho tới." One word (or two) at a time, timed to 120 bpm as if to music, each word landing with weight, varied scale and placement, ending with the whole sentence together. High contrast, two colors plus white.

A 15-second promo for a to-do app called "Doneo": a phone-shaped card with a task list where three tasks get checked off one by one with a satisfying tick, a headline "Việc xong, đầu nhẹ", and a call to action "Tải Doneo miễn phí" at the end. Fresh, light, product-style motion.

A 12-second seamless looping showreel for a small motion design studio called "Nét". One continuous shot, no cuts: everything grows out of a single dot, turns into a few different forms (shapes, a bit of 3D, a small chart), becomes the word "NÉT", and goes back into the dot so the loop point is invisible. Add a soundtrack that fits the cut.
